name: Captain Wrenshall
role: Inspector of N. P. R. C. Co. buildings
mentions: As soon as Capt. Wrenshaw returns from the scene of the washout he will order a number of improvements in the freight house. The west end will be partitioned off into three rooms, and a platform…
Captain Wrenshall returned Tuesday evening to again inspect the N. P. R. C. Co.'s slaughter house buildings here.
